name: long-context-smoke
description: 压缩功能端到端验证 — 5 题, 答案各 ~3k chars, 累计 prior_traces ~12k chars (~3000 tokens). 第 1 题 (token=2000) 触发 sliding window fallback, 验证压缩后 LLM 仍能拿到全部历史. 配套 brain-prefrontal + deepseek 两个 agent. 实测时需要给 deepseek 配置 session.compress_at_tokens=2000 (sliding window fallback path). brain-prefrontal 不配置 session, 用默认 unlimited (模拟生产 agent).

tasks.instruction: Read the file at /tmp/long-prefix-1.txt (5000 chars) and answer with its content. After your answer, append the word DONE on a new line.
